import java.util.*;
public class Main {
    static char[][] mazeA = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] mazeB = new char[20][20];
    static Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static int[][] distanceA = new int[20][20];
    static int[][][][] distanceB = new int[20][20][20][20];
    static int[] deltaX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] deltaY = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static class Edge {
        int from, to, flow, capacity, next;
        public Edge(int from, int to, int flow, int capacity, int next) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head = new int[505];
    static int[] parent = new int[505];
    static int[] visited = new int[505];
    static int[] level = new int[505];
    static int source = 501;
    static int sink = 502;
    static int maxFlowResult = 0;
    static int n, m;
    static int edgeIdx = 0;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, w, head[u]));
        head[u] = edges.size() - 1;
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]));
        head[v] = edges.size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
        Arrays.fill(level, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
        q2.offer(source);
        visited[source] = 1;
        level[source] = 1;
        while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q2.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                if (visited[e.to] == 0 && e.flow < e.capacity) {
                    parent[e.to] = i;
                    q2.offer(e.to);
                    visited[e.to] = 1;
                    level[e.to] = level[x] + 1;
                    if (e.to == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int flow) {
        if (x == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        int remaining = flow;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
            Edge e = edges.get(i);
            if (e.capacity > e.flow && level[e.to] == level[x] + 1) {
                int delta = dfs(e.to, Math.min(remaining, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (delta == 0) level[e.to] = 0;
                e.flow += delta;
                edges.get(parent[e.to] ^ 1).flow -= delta;
                remaining -= delta;
                if (remaining == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return flow - remaining;
    }

    static void computeMaxFlow() {
        while (bfs()) {
            maxFlowResult += dfs(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < 505; i++) {
            head[i] = -1;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                mazeA[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                distanceA[i][j] = 10000;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (mazeA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    distanceA[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (mazeA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, (i - 1) * n + j, mazeA[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] pos = q.poll();
            int x = pos[0], y = pos[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + deltaX[i], ny = y + deltaY[i];
                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && mazeA[nx][ny] <= '9' && distanceA[nx][ny] > distanceA[x][y] + 1) {
                    distanceA[nx][ny] = distanceA[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (mazeA[i][j] > '9') continue;
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        distanceB[i][j][k][l] = 10000;
                    }
                }
                q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                distanceB[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] pos2 = q.poll();
                    int x = pos2[0], y = pos2[1];
                    for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                        int nx = x + deltaX[f], ny = y + deltaY[f];
                        if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && mazeA[nx][ny] <= '9' && distanceB[i][j][nx][ny] > distanceB[i][j][x][y] + 1 && distanceA[x][y] < distanceA[nx][ny]) {
                            distanceB[i][j][nx][ny] = distanceB[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                            q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        if (distanceB[i][j][k][l] <= Math.min(distanceA[k][l], t))
                            addEdge((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                mazeB[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (mazeB[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge((i - 1) * n + j + 100, sink, mazeB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        computeMaxFlow();
        System.out.println(maxFlowResult);
        sc.close();
    }
}
